title: Verb たほうがいい (〜ta hou ga ii)
shortExplanation: Used to give advice or make a suggestion to someone - 'it's better if...'.
longExplanation: The たほうがいい grammar point is used to give advice or make a suggestion to someone. It can be translated as 'it's better if...', 'should', or 'it's a good idea to'. It is formed by conjugating the verb into the past tense (た-form) and adding ほうがいい.

examples.en: It's better if you go to bed early.

examples.jp: もっと勉強したほうがいい。
examples.romaji: Motto benkyou shita hou ga ii.

examples.jp: 病気の時は、薬を飲んだほうがいい。
examples.romaji: Byouki no toki wa, kusuri wo nonda hou ga ii.
examples.en: It's a good idea to take medicine when you're sick.

examples.jp: コーヒーを飲まないほうがいい。
examples.romaji: Koohii wo nomanai hou ga ii.
examples.en: It's better if you don't drink coffee.
